CreateConsumerGroup.title: CreateConsumerGroup
CreateConsumerGroup.summary: Creates a consumer group for ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ. A consumer group is a load balancing group that contains multiple consumers with the same consumption behavior. Consumers must specify a consumer group and the relevant topics to subscribe to messages.

CreateInstance.summary: Creates an ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ 5.x series instance.

CreateInstanceAccount.title: CreateInstanceAccount
CreateInstanceAccount.summary: Creates an access account for an instance.

CreateInstanceAcl.title: CreateInstanceAcl
CreateInstanceAcl.summary: Creates an access control list (ACL) in a specific instance.

CreateTopic.title: Create a topic
CreateTopic.summary: Creates a topic for ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ. A topic is the top-level container for message transmission and storage in ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ, used to identify messages of the same business logic. In the messaging model, producers send messages to a topic, and consumers consume messages by subscribing to a specified topic.

ResetConsumeOffset.title: ResetConsumeOffset
ResetConsumeOffset.summary: Resets the consumer offset of a consumer group. If you reset a consumer offset, the offset from which a consumer starts to consume messages is changed. If faults occur or wrong messages are consumed during message consumption, you can reset the consumer offset to roll back the consumption to a specific offset for reconsumption. You can also reset the consumer offset to the latest offset and temporarily leave the accumulated messages unhandled.
